actions.rationale: open_positions is []. Open $40m of the $100m gross cap in SOFR_2027-03 long duration (receive implied rate). Medium size because US inflation/labor gauges remain hot (72/75) and CME positioning is missing; not 100m because this is event-premium mean reversion, not a call that the Fed is done.

events.invalidation: Another clearly delivered 25bp into the Dec-26 window with SR3H7 implied holding at or above the packet Jun-27 4.72 mid, or hotter US labor/inflation with a re-widening oil tail.
events.rationale: VERIFIED: Sep-16 FOMC hike 25bp to 3.75–4.00% was >90% priced into the decision; SOFR printed 3.85 on 2026-09-17 versus 3.62 the prior session; US 2Y 476bp is the 100th percentile 1y after a +57bp 1m change (z 3.29); SR3H7 implies 4.58, +73bp over SOFR; Saudi STS workaround reduced the extreme oil-supply tail; US inflation/labor gauges remain 72/75 with Aug unemployment 4.1% and payrolls +162k. INFERENCE: the residual Mar-27 hike premium is the crowded energy-hawk overlay described by the last-24h desk thesis, not the minimum path required by the delivered 25bp. A plausible normalization is a partial giveback of that overlay toward the already-priced Dec-26 implied 4.32, not a collapse to 3.85. UNKNOWN: CME SR3/UST positioning; whether August CPI's tightening bias plus still-hot gauges deliver the next 25bp inside the Dec-26 window. Sidecar open_positions is empty, so this is a new OPEN versus the $100m gross cap.
